name: Ahaziah
bio:
Ahaziah, son of Jehoram, became king of Judah at twenty-two and reigned one year in Jerusalem; his mother was Athaliah, daughter of Omri, king of Israel. He walked in the evil ways of Ahab's house, to which he was related by marriage (2 Kings 8:24-27). He joined Jehoram (Joram) king of Israel in battle against Hazael of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, where Jehoram was wounded, and went down to Jezreel to visit the wounded king (2 Kings 8:28-29).

## 📖 Core Story: Death at Megiddo

Ahaziah was visiting the wounded Jehoram at Jezreel when Jehu, newly anointed king of Israel, killed Jehoram in Naboth's field. Seeing this, Ahaziah fled toward the garden house, but Jehu pursued and had him struck down in his chariot as well, on the road up to Gur near Ibleam. Ahaziah managed to flee as far as Megiddo before he died there; his servants carried his body to Jerusalem and buried him with his ancestors in the City of David (2 Kings 9:27-28).
